basis: The previous full actual-AAC audit found both models writing 十一次 for correct 十亿次 and 型 for the code-line classifier. Those are diagnostic clues, not proven wrong actual speech. The candidates also address an observable text-boundary problem: the existing comma separates 行 from 代码.
baseline_policy: Authenticate existing complete actual-final AAC clips and reuse their exact-current two-model observations. Separately replay the existing production MP3 into its actual composite PCM; do not synthesize a fresh baseline or treat a preview as final AAC.
selection_policy: No selected candidate or automatic promotion. Normal-rate original-window fit, word boundaries and two-model output are not listening, phoneme, naturalness or emotional-delivery approval.
